assign.request: ext/tabs: the filling promise in Page.prototype.tabs has no .catch() — a throwing child content() leaves the tab bar blank with no console trace. Fix minimally, update docs, verify on the live dev server, prove with a scratch throwing child.
steps: fix filling promise with attributable error
prove fix with scratch throwing child, then delete it

log.msg: Diagnosis: on a cold boot the rejection isn't fully silent — App.load() awaits App.loaded() (Promise.all over View.stylesheets+loaders) outside its own try/catch, so the rejection propagates to App.instantiate()'s try/catch, which calls this.error(error): a console.error, but ALSO wipes the whole $pages tree and replaces it with a Page Load Error screen — worse than a blank bar. On every later (soft) navigation nothing is that bad: Router.load() never awaits app.loaded() again (loaders only grows, doc/loaders.md), so a rejection there becomes a genuine unhandled promise rejection with no page attribution at all.

Fix: appended .catch(error => console.error(`${this.log_label()}.tabs() failed to fill:`, error)) to the filling chain. filling now always resolves, so App.loaded()'s Promise.all never rejects on a throwing child (no more app-wide wipe on cold boot) and the failure is logged with the page's url attached on every load, cold or soft.

Docs: doc/method/tabs.md traps list gained the fixed behavior (still leaves that set's bar unfilled, but now console.error-reported and attributable); doc/file/tabs.js.md's Improvements item 2 (the missing .catch()) removed since it's fixed, list renumbered.

Verified: node --check on a copy passes. Playwright against the live dev server (port 80): /framework/ext/tabs/, /framework/core/View/, /framework/core/Page/ all render their tab bars (3/8, 1/4, 1/9 bars/tabs respectively) with zero console errors — no regression on the happy path.

Proved the fix: scratch Playwright script built a live Page with a child whose content() throws, called tabs() on it in-browser. Console now shows: page{/scratch-parent/}.tabs() failed to fill: Error: scratch-throwing-child, with a full stack to the throwing content(). Scratch script deleted after.

assign.outcome: **Fixed the uncaught rejection in ext/tabs' filling promise.** `Page.prototype.tabs()` in public/framework/ext/tabs/tabs.js now ends the fill chain with `.catch(error => console.error(`${this.log_label()}.tabs() failed to fill:`, error))`. Diagnosis: on cold boot the rejection was already being caught by App.instantiate()'s try/catch (via App.loaded()'s Promise.all) but at the cost of wiping the whole app into a Page Load Error screen; on every later navigation it was a true unhandled rejection with zero attribution, since Router.load() never awaits app.loaders again. The fix makes filling always resolve, logs the failure tagged with the page's url on both paths, and updates doc/method/tabs.md and doc/file/tabs.js.md accordingly. Verified via Playwright against the live dev server on /framework/ext/tabs/, /framework/core/View/, /framework/core/Page/ (bars render, zero console errors) and proved with a scratch throwing child (now logs cleanly, scratch file deleted).
